assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.text: So in this presentation I'd like to discuss the designers of some everyday objects.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.zh: 所以这次展示中，我想讨论一些日常物品的设计师。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.text: Sir James Dyson and Sir Jonathan Ive.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.zh: 詹姆斯·戴森爵士和乔纳森·艾夫爵士。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.text: These people designed simple things that have changed our lives and how we do everyday things.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.zh: 这些人设计了一些简单的东西，却改变了我们的生活以及我们处理日常事务的方式。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.text: Today we are going to think about these inventors and designers,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.zh: 今天我们将思考这些发明家和设计师，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.text: their achievements and how their inventions and designs have helped us.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.zh: 他们的成就，以及他们的发明和设计怎样帮助了我们。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.text: I would like to start with Arnie Jakobson who was born in Denmark in 1902.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.zh: 我想先介绍阿恩·雅各布森，他1902年出生于丹麦。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.text: When he was a child he loved to paint but his father thought being an artist wasn't a good career.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.zh: 他小时候喜欢画画，但父亲认为当艺术家不是好职业。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.text: So Jakobson became a designer of many things including buildings and furniture.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.zh: 所以雅各布森成了许多事物的设计师，包括建筑和家具。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.text: here is a chair he designed in 1958.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.zh: 这是他1958年设计的一把椅子。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.text: Have any of you seen this kind of chair before?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.zh: 你们有人以前见过这种椅子吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.text: Did they call it the egg chair because of its shape?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a104d31f9a3f41a.zh: 他们把它叫作“蛋椅”，是因为它的形状吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: Yes,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 是的，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: you have a good point.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 你说得有道理。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: I think it was called that because of the egg -like shape.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 我想它之所以叫这个名字，是因为形状像鸡蛋。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: Nowadays we still see Jakobson's designs around us.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 如今我们仍能在身边看到雅各布森的设计。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: When you look at the chair design,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 看这把椅子的设计时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: can you guess what Jakobson was like as a person?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 你能猜出雅各布森是什么样的人吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: His chair looks like a simple neat design.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 他的椅子看起来设计简洁、整齐。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: So maybe he liked simple and neat things and not complicated things.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 所以他可能喜欢简洁整齐的东西，而不喜欢复杂的东西。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: Actually,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 事实上，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: that's right.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 没错。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: He did.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 他确实是这样。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: For example, when he was growing up he painted his room white because he didn't like all the flowers on the wallpaper he had.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 例如，他长大时把房间刷成白色，因为不喜欢墙纸上的花。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: And as an adult he worked hard to make his designs perfect.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 成年后，他努力让自己的设计完美。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: In fact,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 事实上，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: he often kept his workers at work until late trying to make things better.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 他常常让员工工作到很晚，努力把东西做得更好。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: But even though he worked hard,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 不过即使他很努力，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: Jakobson liked to joke and do funny things.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 雅各布森也喜欢开玩笑、做有趣的事。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: For instance,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 例如，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: as a child he liked to play jokes on others and as an adult he once wore a melon for a hat when someone dared him to.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 小时候他喜欢捉弄别人，成年后有人激他时，他曾把一个甜瓜当帽子戴。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: He also liked working on his own projects in his free time and found painting to be relaxing.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 他也喜欢利用空闲时间做自己的项目，并觉得绘画能让人放松。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: These days,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 如今，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: Jakobson is famous for his modern, simple designs.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 雅各布森以现代、简洁的设计闻名。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.text: His work showed that he thought about the purpose that his designs would serve for people.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_767c4c0ddb5006c.zh: 他的作品表明，他考虑过自己的设计将为人们发挥什么作用。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.text: Next,
I'd like to talk about an inventor,
James Dyson.
Can anyone think of something you often use that might have his last name,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.zh: 谁能想到一种你经常使用、上面可能有他的姓氏，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.text: Dyson,
on it?
I know!
A vacuum cleaner!
Or a hand dryer.
Both of those things are correct.
Dyson's designs and inventions are made to solve problems.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.zh: 戴森的设计和发明都是为了解决问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.text: His ideas come because he sees things that could work better, like the vacuum cleaner and hand dryer.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.zh: 他的想法来自于他发现了可以做得更好的东西，比如吸尘器和干手器。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.text: But how did he start?
Well,
Dyson was born in England in 1947.
His father died when he was only nine.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.zh: 他只有九岁时父亲就去世了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.text: As a result,
Dyson ended up becoming someone who never gave up.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.zh: 戴森后来成了一个从不放弃的人。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.text: He studied art and design before he studied engineering.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.zh: 他先学习艺术与设计，之后才学习工程学。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.text: When he saw something that didn't work well,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.zh: 当他看到某件东西不好用，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.text: he got frustrated and worked to improve it.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.zh: 就会感到挫败并努力改进它。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.text: For example,
his first invention was a wheelbarrow with a ball for a wheel.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.zh: 他的第一项发明是一辆车轮是球的独轮车。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.text: This made it easier to carry heavy things in the garden and over rough ground.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.zh: 这使得在花园里和崎岖地面上搬运重物更容易。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.text: It was an interesting new use for a ball.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_34aa8eb31cb32cb.zh: 这是球的一种有趣的新用途。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_00b3d40e62a12a7.text: Also, even though he changed subjects, he was still interested in art as well as designing.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_00b3d40e62a12a7.zh: 此外，尽管他换了学科，他仍然对艺术和设计感兴趣。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_00b3d40e62a12a7.text: Take a look at this photo.
It looks like a waterfall made from glass and water,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_00b3d40e62a12a7.zh: 它看起来像由玻璃和水做成的瀑布，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_00b3d40e62a12a7.text: with the water running up instead of falling down.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_00b3d40e62a12a7.zh: 水向上流而不是向下落。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_00b3d40e62a12a7.text: This was a piece of art that Dyson made in 2003 called Wrong Garden.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_00b3d40e62a12a7.zh: 这是戴森2003年创作的一件艺术品，名为《错花园》。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_00b3d40e62a12a7.text: This shows Dyson's love of good design as well as being an inventor.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_00b3d40e62a12a7.zh: 这表明戴森不仅热爱好的设计，也是一位发明家。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_00b3d40e62a12a7.text: Dyson is still inventing new things,
but he is also interested in supporting education for students and gives money to schools to help students study so they might become inventors too.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_00b3d40e62a12a7.zh: 但他也重视支持学生教育，资助学校帮助学生学习，希望他们也能成为发明家。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_00b3d40e62a12a7.text: He has even donated money to the University of Cambridge to support students and research there with a focus on technology.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_00b3d40e62a12a7.zh: 他甚至向剑桥大学捐款，以技术为重点支持那里的学生和研究。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.text: Now I have one last picture to show you.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.zh: 现在我还有最后一张图片要给大家看。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.text: It's a phone with a special design.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.zh: 这是一部设计独特的手机。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.text: I think a lot of us know about this phone.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.zh: 我想我们中很多人都知道这部手机。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.text: It was designed by Sir Jonathan Ive for Apple.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.zh: 它是由苹果公司的乔纳森·艾夫爵士设计的。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.text: He is responsible for a lot of Apple's product designs, which are simple,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.zh: 他负责了许多苹果产品的设计，设计简洁、

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.text: Ive has won a lot of awards for his Apple designs,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.zh: 艾夫凭借苹果设计获得很多奖项，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.text: and you can see a lot of his work in museums too.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.zh: 你也能在博物馆里看到他的许多作品。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.text: He is from London and he was made a Knight Commander of the British Empire in 2012 for his design work.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.zh: 他来自伦敦，2012年因设计工作获授大英帝国爵级司令勋章。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.text: He is known as being hardworking and creative.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.zh: 他以勤奋和创造力著称。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.text: I think that his designs will continue to influence the way we live and work for a long time.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b83c2ee1dc32be.zh: 我想他的设计会在很长时间内继续影响我们的生活和工作方式。
